startersHint: Choose how many questions your test has. You can change every number under More options.
printHint: Print it on plain A4 paper, one for each student. Students fill one circle for each question with a dark pen or pencil, and write their roll number in the boxes and fill the matching circles.
savePdf: Save the sheet as a PDF
keyHint: Type the right answers in order, such as ABCDDCBA, or as pairs, such as 1A 2C 3B. Questions you leave out are not marked.
photosTitle: 4. Add photos of the filled sheets
photosHint: Take one photo of each sheet from above, in good light, with all four black corner squares in the picture. The sheet can be turned any way. Photos stay on your device.
sampleNote: Makes three made-up filled sheets and a key, so you can see the marking before using your own.
failMarkers: The four black corner squares could not be found. Take the photo again with the whole sheet in view, flat and in good light.
failShape: The sheet could not be lined up. Take the photo again from straight above.
failed: This photo could not be opened.
tooMany: Only the first {max} photos were read.
rollFix: Check this. Some digits could not be read.
rollSame: The same roll number appears on another sheet.
countsLine: {right} right, {wrong} wrong, {blank} left blank, {multiple} with two marks
noKey: Type the answer key above to see the marks.
legend: Green: right. Red: wrong. Orange ring: the right answer that was missed.
perWrong: Marks taken off for a wrong answer
perWrongHint: Leave at 0 for no negative marking. A blank answer or two marks on one question never loses marks.
sensitivity: How dark a mark must be
sensitivityHint: Choose Light pencil if faint marks are missed. Choose Dark only if stray rubbing marks are counted. This changes the marking at once.
includeAnswers: Include every answer in the saved file
sheetChanged: The sheet size changed, so the earlier photos were cleared. Add the photos again.
notSaved: Photos, roll numbers and marks are not saved. Only the sheet size and marking choices are remembered on this device.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.instructions: Use a dark pen or pencil and fill each circle completely. Fill only one circle for each question. Write your roll number in the boxes and fill the circles under it.
